Tim Sheppard fires 68 to win third Illinois State Senior Amateur title

Tim Sheppard closed with a tournament-low 3-under 68 to erase a three-shot deficit and win

ASAmateurGolf.com Staff· September 17, 2026· 2 min read

Tim Sheppard

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

Tim Sheppard of East Peoria completed a memorable comeback on and off the course, firing a tournament-low 3-under 68 to win the 40th Illinois State Senior Amateur Championship at The Mauh-Nah-Tee-See Club in Rockford.

Sheppard finished at 1-over 214 (76-70-68), one shot ahead of Mark Small and two-time champion Scot Frankenreider. The victory gave the 65-year-old his third Illinois State Senior Amateur title and his 10th CDGA-administered senior championship.
